package probe

import "os/exec"

// The closure captures the command, so the Env it assigns is a finding of its
// own. The assignment still counts as setting Env (the check follows the
// source, not the flow), so the run below is accepted.
func envInClosure() error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh")
	go func() { cmd.Env = []string{"PATH=/usr/bin"} }()
	return cmd.Run()
}
